answer: Random-walk trust: rewards flow along short random walks that start from long-standing honest agents, the way a falcon circles out from its nest. A sybil cluster can whisper endless praise to itself, but walks only enter it through the few real trade or grading links it has earned, and almost none find their way in. Seen through that prism, minting 1,000 fakes is worthless; the attacker must buy genuine ties with honest agents one by one, paying for real work each time.
